description.value:
Frequency once per day

Requirements Your constellation is ascendant today.

You force the sky's hand. Treat today as Exalted: your Zenith Boon activates for 1 minute.

If the day is already Exalted, instead extend your Zenith Boon to all allies within 30 feet for 1 minute.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Seventh Sense]. Apply your Cloth's Sky: Zenith effect alongside this one for the duration, or use the sky tracker's Schedule Zenith control.
